title: Behind-wall oxidized fastener patch
change: Add one compact oxidized-fastener patch to a background metal panel.
implementation_notes: Use a small cluster of rust spots with a brighter metal center and place the panel beyond x>=bx+3.
capture_safe_reason: The authored weathering stays behind the wall and uses localized positive-value fastener contrast.
acceptance_test: Capture Combat; verify the patch reads as a small material story without competing with the rifle or reducing target contrast.

title: Instrument cluster bezel separators
change: Add three thin bright bezel separator bars between the main instrument groups.
implementation_notes: Keep bars at x>=bx+3, use light neutral unlit HF values, and preserve all existing instrument faces and panel fill.
capture_safe_reason: Thin separators add readable grouping behind the wall and do not darken or occlude instrument faces.
acceptance_test: Cockpit and ADS remain usable; separators clarify three groups without reducing gauge readability or creating glare.

title: Airframe paint scuff accents
change: Add two or three small pale scuff patches to high-contact airframe zones.
implementation_notes: Use tiny additive masks with subdued neutral-white response; place only on already bright panel edges.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny additive accents are bounded to existing bright edges and cannot turn the FOV into a dark material field.
acceptance_test: Capture PropNose and YakBeauty; confirm scuffs improve authored wear readability without visible glow or camera usability loss.

title: Instrument switch-cap highlights
change: Add five tiny bright shell caps to the visible instrument toggle switches.
implementation_notes: Limit caps to existing switch locations, keep each below pixel-cluster scale where possible, and use restrained additive intensity without bloom.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny additive caps improve instrument specificity without creating a dark panel or large bright region.
acceptance_test: Cockpit remains usable; at least three switch caps are distinguishable and no cap blooms into neighboring gauges.

title: Thin ocean spray fan
change: Add a three-particle additive emissive spray fan to NS_OceanSpray at the principal wave break.
implementation_notes: Use tiny cool-white droplets with narrow spread, low count, and no opaque foam sheet.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny bright droplets preserve ocean readability and avoid broad dark or washed-out water coverage.
acceptance_test: Ocean and Harbor remain usable; spray is confined to the selected wave break.

title: Bright brick tower vertical strip
change: Add one narrow warm-brick vertical facade strip to facade_tower_proxy behind the primary wall.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3 with a single narrow strip, restrained roughness variation, and no dark-only facade material.
capture_safe_reason: The accent stays behind the wall and does not alter the frozen HF silhouette or primary FOV materials.
acceptance_test: Loop52 recipe remains 11/11 usable; City and Wide show one readable brick plane without black-pixel growth.

title: Apartment bright plaster panel
change: Add one pale plaster infill panel to apartment_midrise_proxy behind the wall.
implementation_notes: Use a thin rectangular panel at x>=bx+3 with warm ivory albedo and soft value variation.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny behind-wall geometry adds facade readability without competing with the L52 unlit HF foreground.
acceptance_test: City and Wide retain usable framing and the panel reads as bright plaster rather than a washout patch.
